# Theme compatibility fixture

`todoist-dark.css` is the unchanged published v0.1.0 stylesheet from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hendrik240298/superprod-theme/v0.1.0/todoist-dark.css

SHA256: `49174e6734a5593607f464ae59a189d69627549ee92e24f4fecdd7252348eb98`.

MIT license: see `LICENSE.todoist-dark`. This fixture is test-only; it is neither bundled in the plugin ZIP nor required for using the plugin. Installed-plugin tests add the real stylesheet to an isolated browser context, equivalent to its application as app custom CSS. This does not test the app theme-upload UI or access personal settings.
